svg.title: /0z5a — boot machines of loving grace
svg.desc: A white and baby-blue retro web desktop with gingham, lace and bows. Projects: InfraSWE and FlashNS. Open source: vLLM, vLLM-Omni, DeepSpeed and llm-d. Tools: Python, CUDA, C++, Rust, Linux and Git.
